native.action-value: Gajerar hanya, hanya, URL, rubutu, ko JSON
native.condition-invalid: Shigar da ingantaccen taga ko yanayin app, misali /notepad/i.
native.icon-invalid-image: Zaɓi hoto PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, ko ICO har zuwa 192 KB.
native.imported: An shigo da menu(s) {0} Yi bitar umarnin da aka shigo da su kafin amfani da su, sannan ajiye.
native.label: Lakabi
native.name: Sunan menu
native.shortcut-config-changed: Tsarin menu ya canza akan faifai. Ajiye menu na yanzu don amfani da wannan gajeriyar hanyar.
native.shortcut-in-use: Windows ya ba da rahoton cewa an riga an fara amfani da wannan gajeriyar hanya.
native.shortcut-invalid: Shigar da maɓalli ɗaya, da kowane masu gyara da aka yarda don wannan gajeriyar hanyar.
native.shortcut-save-new-menu: Ajiye wannan sabon menu don kunna gajeriyar hanyarsa.
native.shortcut-saved: An adana gajeriyar hanya: {0}. Yi amfani da shi don buɗe menu lokacin da aka kunna Ayyukan gaggawa.
native.shortcut-unavailable: Windows ba zai iya yin rajistar wannan gajeriyar hanyar ba.

general-settings-dialog.enable-marking-mode-info: Tare da kunna Yanayin Alama, zaku iya zaɓar abubuwa ta jan linzamin kwamfuta akan su.
general-settings-dialog.enable-turbo-mode-info: Tare da kunna yanayin Turbo, kuna iya yin motsin motsi muddin kun riƙe maɓallin gyara kamar Shift ko Ctrl.
general-settings-dialog.middle-mouse-button-behavior-info: Wannan yana ƙayyade abin da zai faru lokacin da aka danna maɓallin linzamin kwamfuta na tsakiya yayin da aka nuna menu.
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center: Matsar da mai nuni zuwa cibiyar menu
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center-info: Idan an duba, za a matsar da mai nuna linzamin kwamfuta zuwa tsakiyar menu ko ƙaramin menu idan ya cancanta. Wannan na iya zama yanayin idan an buɗe menu kusa da gefen allon ko kuma idan an buɗe menu a Yanayin Ciki.
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode: Bukatar danna don zaɓin Yanayin Hover
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode-info: Idan ba a bincika ba, za a zaɓi abubuwa nan da nan lokacin da aka motsa linzamin kwamfuta akan su don menus ta amfani da Hover Mode.
general-settings-dialog.right-mouse-button-behavior-info: Wannan yana ƙayyade abin da zai faru lokacin da aka danna maɓallin linzamin kwamfuta na dama yayin da aka nuna menu.
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release: Rufe menu akan sakin gajeriyar hanya akan tsakiya
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release-info: Wannan zai haifar da aikin danna maɓallin tsakiya lokacin da aka saki maɓalli yayin shawagi akan tsakiyar menu.

settings.shortcut-info: Wannan gajeriyar hanya tana buɗe menu. Dole ne ya ƙunshi maɓallin al'ada ɗaya da kowane adadin masu gyara kamar Ctrl, Alt, ko Shift. Lokacin yin rikodi, ba dole ba ne ka danna duk maɓallan lokaci ɗaya, zaka iya danna su ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Wannan yana da amfani idan an riga an ɗaure gajeriyar hanya zuwa wani menu!
settings.anchored-mode-info: Buɗe menu na ƙasa a wuri ɗaya da menu na iyaye. Duba wannan, zai kashe Yanayin Alama da Yanayin Turbo.
settings.fixed-position-mode-info: Buɗe menu a kafaffen matsayi akan allon, maimakon a siginan kwamfuta.
settings.hover-mode-info: Don masu amfani da wutar lantarki kawai! Zaɓi abubuwa ta shawagi bisa su.
